critical_caveat_the_killer_control_degen.E1_dense_also_skewed: the dense mixture was unbalanced too: expert load [0.128, 0.167, 0.122, 0.583]. Less degenerate than E1S but not uniform.
critical_caveat_the_killer_control_degen.consequence: the E2 - E1S margin of +0.0151 is NOT evidence about CAS routing versus learned sparse routing. It is largely evidence about four working experts versus one. THE KILLER COMPARISON AS RUN IS VOID.
critical_caveat_the_killer_control_degen.finding: E1S, the anonymous sparse top-1 control the owner added as THE fair race, suffered ROUTER COLLAPSE. Measured expert load over the full evaluation surface: [0.001, 0.000, 0.999, 0.000] -- 99.9% of all clauses routed to a single expert, mutual information with class 0.0026 bits. E1S was therefore not 'four anonymous experts with a learned selector'; it was ONE working expert with three dead ones, at a quarter of the active capacity.
critical_caveat_the_killer_control_degen.what_would_fix_it: add a load-balancing loss (or expert-capacity limits) to E1S and re-run that arm. That is an owner decision, not mine -- the standing rule prohibits a second EX1 repair after the result.
critical_caveat_the_killer_control_degen.why_it_happened: no load-balancing auxiliary loss. This is the standard, well-documented MoE failure mode that Switch-Transformer-style load balancing exists to prevent; I did not include one, and the pre-launch review did not catch it either.

headline: CAS-organized experts did NOT clear the registered bar. The decisive number is not the killer comparison -- it is E2 vs E4: a PROVEN class-independent, load-balanced, meaningless partition scored 0.7800 against the CAS partition's 0.7806, a gap of +0.0006 (about a tenth of one paired standard error). A stable arbitrary partition of clauses across four experts does exactly as well as the CAS operation partition. What little advantage exists over a learned router comes from having a FIXED assignment, not from the assignment carrying CAS meaning.

retention_finding.headline: CATASTROPHIC FORGETTING IN EVERY CONDITION. Retained QB_INT accuracy collapsed from ~0.37-0.38 to 0.005-0.041 -- BELOW the 0.0909 chance level for that family, meaning the models did not merely forget but actively re-mapped onto the new task.

retention_finding.reading: expert organization provided essentially NO protection. The spread across all six conditions (0.343 to 0.368) is 0.025 against absolute forgetting of ~0.35 -- under 8% of the effect. E2 forgets 0.0148 less than E1S (below the 0.02 margin, 2/3 seeds), and E0 (a single shared expert) and E4 (meaningless routing) tie for the LEAST forgetting at 0.3432. There is no coherent story in which operation-specific experts protected memory.

the_comparison_that_survives.interpretation: in the owner's own frozen vocabulary this is the substance of CAS_EXPERT_MEANINGS_NOT_LOAD_BEARING. The deterministic law did not emit that status because its test is a strict point-estimate inequality (E4 >= E2) and E4 came in 0.0006 BELOW E2. The status is left exactly as emitted; this note records that the point-estimate test sits on a knife edge while the substance is a tie.
the_comparison_that_survives.note_on_load: E2's experts are unbalanced BY CLASS FREQUENCY ([0.474, 0.081, 0.280, 0.165], mirroring ^2 47% / ^3 8% / ^6 28% / ^8 17%) while E4's are uniform. E4 still matched it.
the_comparison_that_survives.pair: E2 (CAS operation routing) vs E4 (frozen per-clause hash routing)
the_comparison_that_survives.why_valid: E4 was PROVEN class-independent before the run (mutual information 0.000084 bits over 54,000 training clauses; 0.0030 bits measured in-run over the evaluation surface, against E2's 1.7477) and its expert load is near-uniform [0.236, 0.250, 0.264, 0.251] -- four genuinely active experts, no collapse. It is the one four-expert control that did not degenerate.

established_in_development: a stable FIXED partition of clauses across four experts is worth a little over a collapsed learned router, but the partition's SEMANTIC CONTENT is not what does the work (E2 vs E4: +0.0006)
E2 does improve both non-saturated families consistently against E1S (QB_REL +0.0204, QB_INT +0.0542, 3/3 seeds each) -- but E4 gets the same overall result without any CAS meaning
operation-specific experts did not reduce catastrophic forgetting on this task
what_this_does_and_does_not_establish.honest_summary: This is a negative result for CAS expert MEANINGS on this task, delivered by the control that stayed valid (E4), plus a void killer comparison that needs a load-balanced re-run if the owner wants it.
not_established: that CAS expert organization has no value under a NON-degenerate learned sparse control -- E1S collapsed, so that specific race was not actually run
